content:
maria_csm: Quick weekly velocity check for Vega Health — focus on tokens + throughput. Topline: usage up, p95 creeping, small spike in 5xx. Posting snapshot, please react with any immediate blockers.

analytics-bot: ```Account: Vega Health
Week: 2026-03-16 -> 2026-03-22
Tokens (total): 3,240,118  (+18% WoW, +46% QoQ)
Avg throughput: 120 tps (+12% WoW)
P95 latency: 220 ms (+30 ms WoW)
5xx rate: 0.8% (+0.3pp WoW)
Spend (hosted): $4,720 (+22% WoW)
Note: spike on Wed 03:40 UTC correlated with fallback to model-v1-small
```

sam_cs: Thx — growth correlates with last week's background indexing rollout (feature flag). Expect sustained higher tokens. Do we have KV cache hit rate for their routes? Could blunt p95.

joe_support: Saw the 03:40 UTC spike — logs show several requests hit a model-variant fallback and returned 502s. Excerpt: 
```
[03:40:12] request_id=abc123 model=model-v1-large -> fallback model-v1-small 502
[03:40:13] request_id=abc124 model=model-v1-large -> fallback model-v1-small 502
```
No obvious request pattern, seemed capacity-related.

infra-oncall: Confirming — short capacity pressure in dedicated pool eu-west-1. Autoscale didn't add nodes due to a soft quota cap. We raised the quota request at 03:47 and autoscaler resumed at 03:55. Root cause: quota bump pending with cloud. Filed ticket GOV-4682.

maria_csm: Ok — that's helpful. Renewal context: they're on an enterprise trial. Usage growth is good but the latency and 5xx blips increase renewal risk if they see instability. account-ops, any thoughts on financial red flags?

account-ops: Vega's committed spend target is $12k/mo post-trial. Current run-rate is trending to ~$14k/mo (hosted) but with higher variance. Positive signal on adoption, but we need stability and a plan to control unit cost. If p95 stays >200ms next week, escalate renewal touch.

mike_sales: I'll join CSM enablement call Thurs 10am PT and present options: dedicated capacity vs optimized hosted config (prefix caching, batching, quantization suggestions). Prep: cost delta for both paths and a short runbook for reducing p95.

sam_cs: Recommend we run a 48h batch-tuning test (reduce max_batch_latency, increase continuous batching window) — should cut token cost ~10-12% for their pattern. Also toggle prefix/KV caching on the largest routes; analytics, can you surface cacheable route list?

analytics-bot: Quick follow-ups: weekly QoW/QoQ deltas: 
- Tokens: +18% WoW, +46% QoQ
- Throughput (tps): +12% WoW, +38% QoQ
- P95 latency: +15% WoW (from 190ms -> 220ms), +34% QoQ
- 5xx rate: +0.3pp WoW (0.5% -> 0.8%), +0.6pp QoQ
- Spend: +22% WoW, +55% QoQ

maria_csm: Action items: 
1) infra-oncall — update on GOV-4682 quota bump status, aim to close before next spike. (owner: infra-oncall)
2) sam_cs — kick off 48h batch/caching experiment, share config & expected savings. (owner: sam_cs)
3) analytics-bot — send daily delta snapshots (tokens, p95, 5xx) to this thread for 7 days. (owner: analytics-bot)
4) mike_sales — prepare renewal enablement deck with cost/latency tradeoffs for Thurs call. (owner: mike_sales)

Please react with :thumbsup: when you have the first update.
